facts.value: Reads the result JObj's Y translation and TyFiguponUD.x44 velocity. When current_y + velocity is above -6.2, subtracts 0.6 from velocity and adds the new velocity to Y. At impact, calls Toy_80306D14 only when Toy_803048C0(Toy_804A2AA8.xC) equals 1, writes TyModeState.x0 = 1, plays sound 0xA7, sets Y = -7.2, requests controller feedback 0xC, removes user data, and requests removal of the currently executing GObj process.

facts.value: Runs the selected trophy result's gravity-like drop and impact presentation. It initializes temporary velocity state, accelerates the model downward, snaps it to its final height at the impact boundary, performs sound and controller feedback, updates shared Toy mode state, removes the motion data, and removes its own process while leaving the result GObj for later result cleanup.

evidence.why: Complete branching, ordering, and unguarded initialization.
Self-removal rather than suspension.

facts.rationale: Preserves the subtle pre-acceleration threshold and allocation-failure branch while correcting the old suspension claim.
facts.value: Without user data, allocates TyFiguponUD, conditionally attaches it, and then unconditionally initializes x44 to zero; allocation failure is therefore not safely handled. With user data, tests current_y + the existing velocity against -6.2 before applying acceleration. Above the boundary it subtracts 0.6 from velocity and advances Y by the new velocity. At or below the boundary it executes impact feedback, sets Y to -7.2, removes the motion data, requests self-removal, and returns. The result GObj is not destroyed by this callback.

facts.rationale: Corrects input priority, the identity of the second callback, the meaning of the initialized timing field, and process addition versus replacement.
facts.value: Returns immediately unless lottery phase x5C is zero. The menu-exit check and 0x200 minimum-wager/cancel command run before the cooldown check: the latter exits with no whole-coin credit or wager at most one, otherwise resets the wager to one and refreshes presentation. A nonzero cooldown then decrements and suppresses later handling. Unusable-credit input sets a 30-update cooldown; successful maximum/minimum shortcuts set one, and directional steps set three. Wagers are bounded by one, available whole coins, and 20. Confirmation copies x5E to x5D, sets x56 to 30, installs coin-debit and panel-animation processes, sets x5C to 1, and adds the lottery update process to the supplied GObj. It does not remove or replace the input process; the phase guard suppresses that process until idle resumes.

evidence.why: Actual guards, handle clears, two cleanup calls and exit ordering.
Entry allocations are not freed by the local cleanup body.
Process-chain removal does not destroy the owning GObj.
The distinct GObj destruction API used for data->x8.

facts.rationale: Replaces the overbroad claim that populated GObj slots are cleaned and partially initialized state is generally safe. The distinction matters for cross-file scene lifetimes.
facts.value: The scene frame callback invokes this routine when TyModeState.x4 is nonzero, then requests normal scene exit. The routine assumes the shared scene, panel and ED4 state pointers are valid. It independently clears populated archive, auxiliary, panel, lever, carrier, light and camera handle slots, but most such clears do not destroy or free the referenced resources. It removes all processes from data->x0 before clearing that handle, destroys data->x8 before clearing it, and unconditionally stops streamed audio. It does not free the state blocks allocated at entry or constitute complete scene-resource destruction.
